data.title: state.json is a cache and never goes into git
data.why: From CLAUDE.md, invariant I6 and ADR-005 (DOC-8): deleting .kadence/state.json changes nothing, because it is derived from the events and is never a source of truth. init adds it to .gitignore; committing it would create merge conflicts in a file that can always be rebuilt.
data.rejected: Committing the snapshot to save the first fold on a fresh clone: conflicts on every merge, for a file derived from what is already committed
